items.subject: Forward to a Microsoft team?
items.body:
Hi Jason,

Lightmatter lists us on its board as of 2026-11-24. Your Microsoft role was documented as of 2025-03-25. Could you forward the blurb below to the relevant team at Microsoft for photonic computing? A Microsoft-affiliated paper, 'Photonic Ising machines towards and beyond a million spins' (2026-11-19), made me wonder if a short chat could be relevant. No problem at all if you'd rather not.

Nicholas

Blurb you can forward:
Nicholas Harris founded Lightmatter and co-authored 'Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits' (2017). Given Microsoft-affiliated work on photonic Ising machines published 2026-11-19, would a conversation about photonic computing be relevant to your team?
